property: After a finite failed transfer and restoration of fair quorum communication, new application commands must commit within the bounded recovery interval.
method: After healing and transfer completion/failure, require 100 new successful commands and follower convergence within 20 maximum election timeouts. Record transfer flag only as diagnosis; progress is the independent property.
witness_requirements: Transfer initiation and terminal result, fair healed quorum, enabled client submissions, persistent rejection/no commit, controller enabled-set and progress deadline.
